title: Governance surrounds the operating loop
text: The proposed architecture includes evaluations, searchable logs, constrained actions, review queues and rollback around sensing and execution. It is useful as a completeness check: a workflow is not governed merely because a person approved its original launch.
qualification: A proposed architecture, not evidence that the complete system has been independently validated or that every action is reversible.
